Branches.Rule: Validate base/native binary; recognize one actual ASCII sign; trim ASCII zeroes; reject no digit; size above digits_per_small yields big before validating remaining digit bytes.

Actual sign term; signed SMALL eligibility and byte narrowing; wrapped-zero skip; validate SMALL prefix until threshold+1; shorter invalid/residual rejects; threshold+1 yields big even with residual remaining.

Native big marker triggers list_to_binary(original) before big_binary_to_int. This admits nested iodata/binary tails only after sufficient actual prefix; any illegal original byte/type/tail fails before size cap.
Strip sign and leading zeroes from complete byte input. Significant byte size>4194304 =>system_limit all bases; size>1262611 withbase>=10 =>system_limit. This happens before segment digit validation.
All segments validated using native binary_to_integer on short chunks before any combine; malformed byte below publicprecap =>badarg even when mathematical validprefix would exceed maxlimbs.

Nonnegative segments combined associatively; native65535 64-bit limbs =>4194240 magnitudebits. Arithmetic failure returned as reason then public error_with_info(original arguments). Final bit cap is not a replacement for prior publicprecap/validation precedence.

Branches.Source: Current ProcessContext cancellation/ChargeAsync and list traversal scopes
Branches.Rule: Long prepass/flatten/validation/combine must yield/check cancellation and retain original native error arguments while disposing all transient traversal/source scopes. Existing synchronous pure Parse has no ProcessContext and cannot independently establish this obligation.
